title.zh: 基本再生数 R₀ · 传播曲线
title.en: The basic reproduction number R₀ · epidemic curves

description.zh: R₀ 是一个病例在没人免疫、没有干预时平均传给几个人：大于 1，开头病例一代比一代多；但病人康复后免疫，易感者越来越少，降到总人口的 1/Rₑ 时曲线掉头，这就是群体免疫阈值。干预把有效再生数 Rₑ 压低，峰值变低变晚，但变平不等于消失。
description.en: R₀ is how many people one case infects on average when nobody is immune and nothing is done: above 1, cases multiply each generation at first; but recovered people are immune, susceptibles run down, and when they fall to 1/Rₑ of the population the curve turns — the herd-immunity threshold. Interventions push the effective number Rₑ down, so the peak is lower and later — but flatter is not the same as gone.

reason.zh: 每个病例传给 R 个人，开头病例数就一代乘一次 R：R > 1 时指数增长，R < 1 时指数衰减。页面的 SIR 曲线开头正是这段指数增长，之后易感者耗尽才把它压弯。
reason.en: Each case passes it to R others, so early on case numbers are multiplied by R every generation: exponential growth when R > 1, exponential decay when R < 1. The page’s SIR curve starts with exactly that exponential rise, until running out of susceptibles bends it over.
